description: The frontmatter a skill's `SKILL.md` opens with: what an agent loads for every skill at startup.

examples.description: A description of what this skill does and when to use it.
examples.name: skill-name

examples.description: Extract PDF text, fill forms, merge files. Use when handling PDFs.
examples.name: pdf-processing

name.description: The skill's name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, neither starting nor ending with a hyphen and never two in a row. It must match the name of the directory the skill sits in.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it, with the keywords that let an agent match it to a task.
examples: Extracts text and tables from PDF files, fills PDF forms, and merges multiple PDFs. Use when working with PDF documents or when the user mentions PDFs, forms, or document extraction.

license.description: The license the skill is under: a license's name, or the name of a license file bundled with the skill.

compatibility.description: The environment the skill needs: the product it is meant for, the system packages it runs, or network access. Most skills need none, and leave it out.
examples: Designed for Claude Code (or similar products)
Requires git, docker, jq, and access to the internet

metadata.description: Properties the specification does not define, for clients to read: string keys to string values, so a number is quoted. Keys are best made unique enough not to collide with another client's.

allowed-tools.description: The tools the skill may run without asking, separated by spaces. Experimental: support for it varies between agents.
examples: Bash(git add *) Bash(git commit *) Bash(git status *)

title: Agent Skill frontmatter
